thread:
Linda: Heads-up: ap-south1 warmpool showing repeated tiny-pod scatter + eviction spikes for ~35m. Packing index dropped sharply.
Omar: Any attach errors or node flips?
Linda: events snippet: `Warning FailedAttachVolume 3m (x11 over 30m) attachdetach-controller attach failed: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded` and `Warning NodeNotReady 2m kubelet node ap-south1-np-12 briefly NotReady`
Felix: Pattern looks like transient attach/network blips -> kubelet taints -> scheduler immediately reschedules small pods across nodes -> fragmentation.
Rachel: Cost hit?
Linda: Early ballpark: +7-10% GPU-hours on that pool last couple hours due to reboots/reschedules.
Omar: We should avoid immediate eviction on short NotReady. Current nodeFlipGrace=10s which is too aggressive for this flakiness.
Felix: Agreed. Short checklist: 1) canary bump kubelet attachTimeout to 45s on warmpool-canary, 2) enable delayed-taint-lift so taint is removed only after a stabilization window, 3) apply a scheduler softening for tiny pods on that nodepool (lower preferSpreadThreshold / increase packing bias).
Ops-automation-bot: I can apply a scoped scheduler patch. Example: `kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -n kube-system --type merge -p '{"data":{"nodeFlipGrace":"30s","packingBias":"0.7","preemptScoreScale":"0.6"}}'` (can target via node labels).
Omar: Let's do kubelet canary first then scheduler softening if we see improvement.
Sre-bot: alert: evictions-high firing for cluster/ap-south1 (4m)
Linda: Patching warmpool-canary kubelet now: `kubectl patch cm warmpool-canary-kubelet -n infra --patch '{"data":{"attachTimeout":"45s"}}'`
Ops-automation-bot: Kubelet config patched for warmpool-canary-a  rollout triggered.
Rachel: Monitoring canary metrics. If packing index improves and evictions drop we expand.
Felix: Also capture NIC firmware/kernel and cloud attach latency traces for affected hosts and open infra ticket if pattern repeats.
Linda: Canary shows evictions down ~62% after 9m and packing index trending up.
Omar: Good. Schedule expansion to a second canary in 10m and start cost delta logging.
Ops-automation-bot: Temporary scheduler config applied to canary; will auto-revert in 2h unless promoted.
Sre-bot: alert: evictions-high cleared for cluster/ap-south1 (now resolved in canary).
Rachel: Follow-ups: infra/attach-investigation (NIC firmware + attach path), infra/scheduler-ci (simulate 10-20s NotReady flaps), and ops/cost-tracking for uplift.
Felix: Assigning Linda and Omar on the attach-investigation. Thanks all.
